description: Vattenströmmar i Färöbankens kanal 1983 is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Sveriges meteorologiska och hydrologiska institut. Measurements in the Faroe Bank Channel from the research vessel N/O SVANIC in May 1983. Coverage: Sveriges meteorologiska och hydrologiska institut. The portal shows the English title as "Deep-water flow in the Faroe Bank Channel 1983" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Sveriges meteorologiska och hydrologiska institut. Its keywords include Hydrografi, OCEAN CURRENTS, Hydrography, ocean current. The listing shows 2019-05-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
